map.不同操作者间差异 使用指南: Variation Between Different Operators User Guide
map.输入多名操作者各自测量同一零件的平均值，取其均值极差除以系数 d₂* 得到再现性: Enter the mean values measured by several operators on the same part, take the range of those means divided by the coefficient d2* to get the reproducibility sigma_o. Used to assess human reading differences between operators, a key indicator in measurement system analysis.
map.再现性 = 操作者均值极差 / d₂*。: Reproducibility = range of operator means / d2*.
map.：AV = sqrt((XbarDiff*K2)^2 - EV^2/(n*r)): : AV = sqrt((XbarDiff*K2)^2 - EV^2/(n*r)). Example: operator mean difference 0.005, K2 = 0.5231, AV about 0.0021.
map.：查 d₂*=1.128，σ_o=0.06/1.128=0.0532。再现性反映: : Looking up d2* = 1.128, sigma_o = 0.06/1.128 = 0.0532. Reproducibility reflects differences between people and usually needs to be reduced by standard operating instructions.
map.由测量系统误差与公差求 %GRR: %GRR from measurement system error and tolerance
map.由扩展不确定度求单侧 95% 保护带: One-sided 95% guard band from expanded uncertainty
map.是，反映培训/手法差异。: Yes, it reflects differences in training and technique.
map.标准化操作、夹具化、加强培训。: Standardize operations, use fixtures, strengthen training.
